# Command forms of several families the other corpora do not reach: /time of <clock>, /experience set, /effect infinite,
# /execute unless score/items/slots, /swing, /compute, qualified /gamerule names, /place without a position, /publish.
# Flat world, creative; Bot = op at 0.5 -60 0.5, Bot0 = level 0.

gamerule spawn_mobs false
gamerule random_tick_speed 0
# the game time moves between two runs of vanilla itself: freeze it
tick freeze
time of minecraft:overworld set 0
time of minecraft:the_end set 0

# ---- setup ----
scoreboard objectives add o dummy
scoreboard objectives add p dummy
scoreboard players set #a o 5
scoreboard players set #b p 9
scoreboard players set #c o 9
scoreboard players set #c p 9
setblock 0 -60 3 minecraft:chest{Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:apple",count:3}]}
